lines.sub: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson sixteen — “Reminders”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is Lira's Academy, lesson sixteen — Reminders.

lines.sub: Important things are easy to forget: call mom, pay for the internet, take out the trash on Tuesdays.
lines.tts: Important things are easy to forget: call mom, pay for the internet, take out the trash on Tuesdays.

lines.sub: Just say: “Remind me tomorrow at nine to call mom.” I'll understand the time and the task myself.
lines.tts: Just say: Remind me tomorrow at nine to call mom. I'll understand the time and the task myself.

lines.sub: Repeats — the way you say them: “on weekdays except Friday”, “every Tuesday and Thursday”, “every month on the fifth”.
lines.tts: Repeats — the way you say them: on weekdays except Friday, every Tuesday and Thursday, every month on the fifth.

lines.sub: At the right moment I'll ring and say it out loud. Answer “Got it” — and I'll go quiet.
lines.tts: At the right moment I'll ring and say it out loud. Answer Got it — and I'll go quiet.
No time — Snooze for ten minutes.

lines.sub: On the phone, reminders ring on their own — even when the computer is off.
lines.tts: On the phone, reminders ring on their own — even when the computer is off.

lines.sub: All reminders are in the studio, “Tasks and reminders”, and in the calendar: you can change the time in one tap.
lines.tts: All reminders are in the studio, Tasks and reminders, and in the calendar: you can change the time in one tap.
Dewiar is free, at dewiar dot pro.

lines.sub: See you in the next lesson!
lines.tts: See you in the next lesson!
